name: How long does a typical bathroom remodel take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom remodel take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom remodel depends on its complexity and size. A small powder room update might take 1-2 weeks. A standard full bathroom remodel, involving new fixtures, tiling, and possibly minor layout changes, typically takes 3-4 weeks from demolition to completion. Larger master bathroom remodels, especially those requiring significant layout alterations, custom elements, or relocation of plumbing, can extend to 6-8 weeks or more. Unexpected issues can also add to the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom remodels typically take 1-2 weeks for a small update, 3-4 weeks for a standard full bath, and 6-8+ weeks for larger master baths.
